tables.name: fiscal_runtime_audit
constraints: fiscal_audit_predecessor_consistent:CHECK (((NULLIF((payload ->> 'previous_hash'::text), ''::text) IS NULL) OR (NULLIF((payload ->> 'prev_hash'::text), ''::text) IS NULL) OR ((payload ->> 'previous_hash'::text) = (payload ->> 'prev_hash'::text))))
indexes: fiscal_runtime_audit_pkey:CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fiscal_runtime_audit_pkey ON public.fiscal_runtime_audit USING btree (event_id)
fiscal_runtime_audit_tenant_chain:CREATE INDEX fiscal_runtime_audit_tenant_chain ON public.fiscal_runtime_audit USING btree (tenant_id, occurred_at, event_id, previous_hash, event_hash)
fiscal_runtime_audit_tenant_time:CREATE INDEX fiscal_runtime_audit_tenant_time ON public.fiscal_runtime_audit USING btree (tenant_id, occurred_at, event_id)

tables.name: fiscal_runtime_resources
indexes: fiscal_runtime_device_serial_per_tenant:CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fiscal_runtime_device_serial_per_tenant ON public.fiscal_runtime_resources USING btree (tenant_id, lower((data ->> 'serial'::text))) WHERE (kind = 'device'::text)

fiscal_runtime_one_organization_per_tenant:CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fiscal_runtime_one_organization_per_tenant ON public.fiscal_runtime_resources USING btree (tenant_id) WHERE (kind = 'organization'::text)

fiscal_runtime_resource_code_per_tenant_kind:CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fiscal_runtime_resource_code_per_tenant_kind ON public.fiscal_runtime_resources USING btree (tenant_id, kind, lower((data ->> 'code'::text))) WHERE (kind = ANY (ARRAY['location'::text, 'register'::text, 'operator'::text]))
fiscal_runtime_resources_pkey:CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fiscal_runtime_resources_pkey ON public.fiscal_runtime_resources USING btree (kind, id)
fiscal_runtime_resources_tenant_kind:CREATE INDEX fiscal_runtime_resources_tenant_kind ON public.fiscal_runtime_resources USING btree (tenant_id, kind, updated_at)
